description: This file defines a test peer class for accessing private members of QuicCryptoServerConfig in the QUIC protocol implementation, including methods for configuration management, token validation, and debugging.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerConfigPeer
classes.description: A test peer class for accessing private members of QuicCryptoServerConfig.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration associated with a given config ID.

methods.name: GetProofSource
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the ProofSource object.

methods.name: ResetProofSource
methods.description: Resets the proof_source_ member with a new ProofSource.

methods.name: NewSourceAddressToken
methods.description: Generates a new valid source address token.

methods.name: ValidateSourceAddressTokens
methods.description: Validates tokens in the provided source address token list.

methods.name: ValidateSingleSourceAddressToken
methods.description: Validates a single source address token.

methods.name: CheckConfigs
methods.description: Checks the configuration states against expected values.

methods.name: ConfigsDebug
methods.description: Returns debugging information about loaded configs.

methods.name: SelectNewPrimaryConfig
methods.description: Selects a new primary configuration after a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: CompressChain
methods.description: Compresses a certificate chain for caching.

methods.name: source_address_token_future_secs
methods.description: Returns the future seconds for source address tokens.

methods.name: source_address_token_lifetime_secs
methods.description: Returns the lifetime seconds for source address tokens.
